# Poolnautics

> Pool service software for pool route companies. Recurring billing and autopay, late fees and overdue reminders that run themselves, routing, chemical tracking, service reports, quotes and work orders, a technician app, and free migration from Skimmer, QuickBooks or any spreadsheet (a free importer on every plan; white-glove migration above 50 active customers).

Poolnautics is priced by active customers, with unlimited technicians and office staff on every plan. Paused customers don't count toward the price. New pool companies can start a 30-day free trial with no card needed (https://app.poolnautics.app/signup), and the Poolnautics team moves their customers over for them.

## Plans

- Insight: from $49/month for up to 50 active customers, up to $1,299/month for up to 2,500, billed monthly; 25% less billed yearly. Includes unlimited technicians and office staff, zero-click billing and autopay, card fees passed on to customers (where state law allows), late fees and overdue reminders that run themselves, chemicals on invoices and chemical cost per visit, quotes and work orders, drag-and-drop routing, an offline technician app, and free white-glove migration above 50 active customers.
- Vision: from $79/month for up to 50 active customers, up to $2,079/month for up to 2,500, billed monthly; 25% less billed yearly. Everything in Insight, plus automatic pause for customers who don't pay, fleet (truck check-ins and oil change reminders), mileage tracking, connections to Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, automations such as invoicing when a job is done, texting through Quo, Twilio, Telnyx or Dialpad, bulk email from the company's own domain, an API and webhooks, a "Vanishing Discount" price adjuster and a route handover tool.
- More than 2,500 active customers: custom pricing.

Customers' payments go to the pool company's own Stripe account; Poolnautics takes no cut of them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://getpoolnautics.com/): what Poolnautics does, with a live preview of the dashboard and a day of automated billing, routes and fleet
- [Pricing](https://getpoolnautics.com/pricing): plans, what each includes, prices by company size, and pricing questions
- [Recurring billing](https://getpoolnautics.com/pool-service-billing): each customer's own rate, billing day and payment terms; invoices sent in the morning billing run (8:30 AM weekdays, 10:30 AM weekends) and autopay charged; what happens when an invoice goes unpaid (reminders, late fees, pausing); billing on each plan; billing questions
- [Repair requests, diagnostics and work orders](https://getpoolnautics.com/workflow): how a repair goes from a request to a quote or invoice, a work order and a paid invoice, with one step for the office
- [Mileage tracking](https://getpoolnautics.com/pool-service-mileage-tracking): Poolnautics measures the miles between every stop by GPS, leaves the commute out, and gives you a stop-by-stop mileage log to export for your accountant
- [Fleet management](https://getpoolnautics.com/pool-service-fleet-management): Truck check-ins from the tech app, oil change reminders at 500 miles out, and plate and insurance expiry alerts, for pool service companies
- [AI and automations](https://getpoolnautics.com/ai-and-automations): connecting Claude, Grok, ChatGPT or your own AI, automations, and the API
- [Poolnautics for Claude](https://getpoolnautics.com/claude): the Poolnautics connector for Claude: what it does, how to set it up, and its limits
- [Technician app](https://getpoolnautics.com/tech-app): the phone app for routes, chemistry and service reports. Free on the App Store for iPhone (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6829012346); technicians sign in with an invite from their company.
- [Partner program](https://getpoolnautics.com/partners)
- [Contact](https://getpoolnautics.com/contact)
